question: What unchanged per-view rankings and Top-1-minus-Top-2 margins occur on the two frozen initial observations and the one fixed next-frame action?

predecessor.single_change: Open only the six source-frozen images and run the unchanged proposal, SAM2 and DINOv2 scorer independently on the three ordered query views.

proposal.selection: Union unchanged full-frame proposals with fixed 40-percent corner-tile proposals; no query truth access.

tiling.merge: Retain up to 16 full-frame and 8 per tile, remap to full-image coordinates, then score without NMS or truth filtering.

descriptor.feature: Final-layer foreground mean chooses among the same three target references; normalized foreground patches from zero-based DINOv2 block 18 supply the unchanged local score.

appearance.score: For the final-layer-selected target reference, average each query patch maximum cosine to reference foreground patches; fuse equally with final-layer target-memory score.

masker.contract: Apply unchanged native SAM2 to every retained proposal; truth evaluates ranking only after all scores are fixed.

evaluation.truth_role: Truth enters only after each complete per-view ranking is fixed. Initial margins are computed from scores only; target IoU evaluates the fixed policy afterward.

literature_motivation.source: PInVerify: An Offline Embodied Benchmark for Active Instance Verification
literature_motivation.use: Evaluate one deterministic local action rather than assuming random, farthest or MLLM view choice helps.

literature_motivation.source: Active Perception for Ambiguous Objects Classification
literature_motivation.use: Measure whether an ambiguity-triggered view changes the competing-instance ranking.

forbidden_after_freeze: change images, models, proposal pool, masks, features, fusion, query order, trigger threshold or IoU gate after observing output
use target truth to compute the trigger
claim per-view materialization as policy success or fresh confirmation
claim_boundary: This materializes unchanged per-view rankings on one locally pre-existing Development family. It cannot establish fresh transfer, a deployable active-view selector, calibrated uncertainty, exact-instance binding, portal ownership, affordance, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, benefit, reliability or safety.
